Translation.Task Restore Failed: This task does not contain reusable generation settings.
Translation.Task Configuration Loaded: The historical task configuration has been loaded. Review it, then click Generate Video.
Translation.Task Restore Local Materials Warning: Local materials cannot be restored automatically. Please upload them again.
Translation.Task Restore Custom Audio Warning: Custom audio cannot be restored automatically. Please upload it again.
Translation.Video Encoder Help: Advanced option. Default follows the app's stable encoder policy, currently libx264. If a selected hardware encoder is unavailable, the app automatically falls back to libx264.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama:
##### Ollama Configuration
- **API Key**: not required
- **Base Url**: usually `http://localhost:11434/v1` for local runs or `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` for Docker{docker_hint}
- **Model Name**: required; run `ollama list` and enter an installed model, such as `qwen:7b`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.ollama.docker_hint: > Container environment detected. If Base Url is empty, `http://host.docker.internal:11434/v1` is used by default.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.openai:
##### OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [OpenAI Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`; enter another endpoint when using a compatible service
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
> Accessing the official service may require a network proxy in some regions
Translation.llm_provider_tips.aihubmix:
##### AIHubMix Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [AIHubMix console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.aimlapi:
##### AIML API Configuration
- **API Key**: create one at [AIML API]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.evolink:
##### EvoLink Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [EvoLink]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.volcengine:
##### VolcEngine Ark Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the Ark console; [register on VolcEngine]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; make sure the model is enabled in your Ark account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.moonshot:
##### Kimi / Moonshot Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [Kimi Open Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://platform.kimi.ai/docs/models?aff=MoneyPrinterTurbo)

Why recommended:
- **Fits the video creation workflow**: helps generate scripts, extract stock-footage search keywords, and improve final footage relevance
- **Strong long-context capability**: useful for longer topics, batch scripts, and complex prompts
- **Flexible billing**: pay only for what you use, with transparent costs
Translation.llm_provider_tips.oneapi:
##### OneAPI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in your own OneAPI deployment; see the [OneAPI project]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: required; enter the OneAPI service endpoint
- **Model Name**: required; enter a model ID configured in OneAPI
Translation.llm_provider_tips.qwen:
##### Qwen Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [DashScope]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://help.aliyun.com/zh/dashscope/developer-reference/model-introduction#3ef6d0bcf91wy)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.azure:
##### Azure OpenAI Configuration
- **API Key**: obtain one from the [Azure Portal]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: required; enter the Azure OpenAI endpoint, such as `https://<resource>.openai.azure.com`
- **Model Name**: enter the Deployment Name; see the [deployment guide](https://learn.microsoft.com/azure/ai-services/openai/how-to/create-resource)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.gemini:
##### Gemini Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Google AI Studio]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`
Translation.llm_provider_tips.grok:
##### Grok Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [xAI Console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.groq:
##### Groq Configuration
- **API Key**: create one in the [Groq Console]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; available models can also be loaded from the API
Translation.llm_provider_tips.deepseek:
##### DeepSeek Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [DeepSeek Platform]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account
Translation.llm_provider_tips.mimo:
##### Xiaomi MiMo Configuration
- **API Key**: create one by following the [MiMo documentation]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another supported model ID
Translation.llm_provider_tips.modelscope:
##### ModelScope Configuration
- **API Key**: create one by following the [ModelScope documentation]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; see the [model list](https://modelscope.cn/models?filter=inference_type&page=1)
Translation.llm_provider_tips.cloudflare:
##### Cloudflare AI Gateway Configuration
- **API Key**: create a token in the [Cloudflare dashboard]({api_key_url}) with `AI Gateway - Read`, `AI Gateway - Edit`, and `Workers AI - Read` permissions
- **Account ID**: enter your Cloudflare account ID
- **Gateway ID**: defaults to `{default_gateway_id}`; you can also enter an existing Gateway ID
- **Base Url**: not required; the REST API endpoint is generated from the Account ID
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format for another model supported by AI Gateway
Translation.llm_provider_tips.minimax:
##### MiniMax Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on the [China platform](https://platform.minimaxi.com/) or [international platform](https://platform.minimax.io/)
- **Base Url**: use `https://api.minimaxi.com/v1` for China or `{default_base_url}` for international access (default)
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID available to your account

Make sure the API Key and Base Url belong to the same platform, or authentication may fail.
Translation.llm_provider_tips.pollinations:
##### Pollinations AI Configuration
- **API Key**: create one on [Pollinations]({api_key_url})
- **Base Url**: defaults to `{default_base_url}`
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; you can also enter another model ID from the [model catalog](https://gen.pollinations.ai/v1/models) that supports Chat Completions
Translation.llm_provider_tips.litellm:
##### LiteLLM Configuration
- **API Key**: not entered here; configure the target Provider key through environment variables
- **Base Url**: not required
- **Model Name**: defaults to `{default_model}`; use the `provider/model` format and see the [Provider list](https://docs.litellm.ai/docs/providers)

Translation.Use Custom System Prompt Help: When enabled, this replaces the default script generation rules. Intended for advanced prompt users.

Translation.Smart B-Roll Queries Help: Generate concrete scene-based search queries from the script, such as family checking bills at kitchen table, instead of short generic keywords. Uses the current LLM provider.
Translation.Video Diversity Level Help: Controls how many result pages are sampled when searching online video materials. 1 keeps the fastest standard search. Higher values can improve variety, but may take longer and use more API quota.
Translation.Avoid Recently Used Videos Help: When enabled, online clips used in the last 7 days are skipped when possible. If too few fresh clips are available, generation falls back to the normal candidate pool.
Translation.Recently Used Video Window Help: Choose how long a used online clip should be treated as recently used. This only affects the checkbox above.

Translation.Similar Subject Fresh Angle Suggestions:
Fresh angles for "{subject}":
- Focus on a different audience or skill level
- Turn it into a mistake, checklist, or myth-busting format
- Add a current-year update, comparison, or concrete example
Translation.Normalize Narration Loudness Help: Keeps TTS or uploaded narration at a more consistent listening level. The original uploaded file stays unchanged.
Translation.Karaoke Word Highlight Help: Uses TTS word or phrase timing to show subtitles piece by piece. Falls back to classic subtitles when timing data is unavailable.
Translation.Video Sources Help: Multiple sources are searched in parallel and the best clips are selected automatically.

Translation.Video Transition Mode Help: Choose how clips meet. Crossfade blends clips gently and is the recommended default.

Translation.Public YouTube Upload Blocked: Public is selected, but the confirmation is off. The backend will send YouTube uploads as private.
Translation.Upload-Post Not Configured: Upload-Post is not configured. Add the API key and username before uploading.
Translation.Confirm Public Upload: I confirm this video will be published publicly on YouTube
Translation.Confirm Public Upload Help: Required only when YouTube privacy is public.
Translation.Upload Video Missing: Video file was not found locally. Regenerate the video or check the file path before uploading.
Translation.Manual Video Selection Help: Search candidate clips first, then choose exactly which online videos should be used for generation.
Translation.Please Select at Least One Video Candida: Please select at least one video candidate
Translation.Viral Analysis Panel Help: Score the current script and compare improvement suggestions before applying them.
Translation.Auto Viral Analysis After Video Help: Disabled by default to avoid extra LLM usage. Enable it when you want each completed video to get a pre-publish hook and pacing review.
Translation.Content Preflight Help: Run a quick topic and script check before generating. This is advisory and never blocks generation.
Translation.Content Preflight Missing Warning: Content preflight has not been run for the current inputs. Generation will continue.
Translation.Content Preflight Stale Warning: Content preflight was generated for older inputs. Generation will continue.
Translation.Preflight Script Repeat Warning: A recent script is very similar. Review it before generating.
Translation.AI Disclosure Review Help: Review the platform's AI or synthetic-content disclosure requirement before uploading.
Translation.Confirm AI Disclosure Review: I reviewed the AI content disclosure
Translation.Confirm AI Disclosure Review Help: Confirm that you reviewed the platform's disclosure requirement for this upload.
Translation.Publish Insights Insufficient Data: {samples} of {minimum} metric samples are available. Collect more before changing the workflow.
Translation.Publish Insights Advisory: Read-only: these insights never change generation or publishing settings automatically.
Translation.Publish Insight Collect Metrics: Capture metrics for more published videos before changing the production workflow.
Translation.Publish Insight Manual Review: Use these aggregated results as a review aid; generation and publishing settings are not changed automatically.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Alignment: Higher script-quality scores align with stronger engagement in this sample; keep the quality gate as a manual review signal.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Recheck: Higher script-quality scores do not yet align with stronger engagement; review the quality gate manually.
Translation.Publish Insight Quality Inconclusive: Script-quality scores and engagement are too close in this sample to support a workflow change.
Translation.Publish Insight Collect Quality Scores: Collect more script-quality scores before evaluating their relationship to engagement.
Translation.Publish Insight Fallback: Review the available publish metrics manually.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Enabled Help: When enabled, low preflight viral scores show a warning only. Generation is not blocked.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Threshold Help: Warn when the latest fresh preflight score is below this value.
Translation.Viral Quality Gate Warning: Viral score is {score}/100, below the warning threshold of {threshold}/100. Generation will continue.
Translation.Quality Gate Calibration Summary: {samples} publish metric samples. Suggested warning threshold: {threshold}/100.
Translation.Improve Script Help: Generate an alternative script from the viral analysis. The original script is not changed until you apply it.
Translation.Improve Script Unavailable: Could not generate an improved script: {error}
Translation.Script Improvement Comparison Help: Compare the current script with the AI suggestion before applying it.
Translation.Rewrite Improves Score: The suggested rewrite improves the overall score.
Translation.Rewrite Lowers Score: The suggested rewrite lowers the overall score. Review before applying.
Translation.Rewrite Score Unknown: Score comparison is not available. Review the rewrite manually.
Translation.Production Hub Description: Create the topic and script, review quality signals, then generate from the same production desk.
Translation.Production Step Flow Help: Use the tabs below as a workflow: set up the video, review quality, then prepare final generation.
Translation.Production Step Setup Description: Topic, script, media, voice, and output settings.
Translation.Production Step Quality Check Descriptio: Content preflight, viral score, and script improvement.
Translation.Production Step Preview Description: Final checks, generation actions, and recent outputs.
Translation.Final Readiness Help: Final check before rendering: topic, script, quality signals, social text, and publishing status.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Subject: Add a topic before generating the video.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Script: Add or generate a script before rendering.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Preflight: Content preflight has not been run or needs refresh.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Viral Analysis: Viral analysis is missing for the current script.
Translation.Final Readiness Needs Social Metadata: Social media text is not ready yet.
Translation.Final Readiness Ready: The main checks are ready for generation.
Translation.Distribution Readiness Help: Check social metadata, publishing status, and upload safety before generation.
Translation.Distribution Workflow Help: Prepare captions first, then review publishing, auto-upload, and YouTube visibility.
Translation.Distribution Needs Social Metadata: Social media text has not been generated yet.
Translation.Distribution Public Upload Needs Approva: Public YouTube upload is selected but still needs explicit approval.
Translation.Distribution Publishing Optional: Publishing is disabled; the video will still be rendered locally.
Translation.Batch History Readiness Help: Check queued batch ideas, recent outputs, and calibration samples in one place.
Translation.Batch Ready for Generation: Batch items are ready for generation.
Translation.Batch History Has Recent Jobs: No batch is queued, but recent jobs are available for review.
Translation.Batch Needs Ideas: Add batch subjects or script blocks to prepare bulk generation.
Translation.Preset Readiness Help: Check saved presets, starter presets, and active video sources before editing settings.
Translation.Built-in Presets Available: Starter presets are available for this project.
Translation.Preset Needs Save: No preset is saved yet; save the current setup after tuning it.
Translation.Content Plan Readiness Help: Review plan source, idea count, calendar coverage, and warnings before using the plan.
Translation.Content Plan Needs Ideas: No content ideas are available yet.
Translation.Content Plan Needs Review: The content plan has warnings that should be reviewed.
Translation.Content Plan Ready: Content plan is ready to use.
Translation.Quality Check Workspace Help: Run preflight, review viral potential, and improve the script before final generation.
Translation.Quality Gate Review Help: Use the current checks to decide whether to refresh analysis, improve the script, or move to preview.
Translation.Quality Workflow Help: Follow the production checks in order: plan, preflight, viral score, then script improvement.
Translation.Quality Warning Checklist Help: Review the strongest warnings before moving to preview.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Input Help: Add a topic or script before reviewing quality.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Preflight Help: Run topic analysis to check repeats, hooks, and planning risks.
Translation.Quality Decision Refresh Preflight Help: The topic or script changed after the last analysis.
Translation.Quality Decision Needs Viral Analysis He: Score the current script before deciding whether to improve it.
Translation.Quality Decision Review Rewrite Help: An improved script is ready; compare it before applying.
Translation.Quality Decision Low Score Help: The current quality gate threshold is not met.
Translation.Quality Decision Review Warnings Help: There are preflight or viral warnings to inspect before generation.
Translation.Quality Decision Ready Help: Quality checks look ready for the final generation step.
Translation.Production Workspace Help: A compact map of presets, batch work, content intelligence, publishing, quality checks, and recent output.
Translation.Workspace Tab Setup Help: Save, import, and reuse production presets before changing the current project.
Translation.Workspace Tab Planning Quality Help: Create content plans, run preflight checks, score viral potential, and review script improvements.
Translation.Workspace Tab Distribution Help: Prepare social captions, hashtags, platform metadata, and upload defaults.
Translation.Workspace Tab Batch History Help: Prepare batch subjects, inspect recent jobs, and record publish metrics.
Translation.Generate Actions Help: Render one video now or run the prepared batch queue.
Translation.Subject: Subject
Translation.Sync Metrics No Data: No Upload-Post metrics were available yet.
Translation.Generate Decision Help: Shows the safest next production action before rendering.
Translation.Generate Decision Ready: Single video is ready to generate.
Translation.Generate Decision Batch Ready: Batch subjects are ready for bulk generation.
Translation.Accounts API Readiness Help: Checks AI, media, voice, and publishing setup without showing secrets.
Translation.Accounts LLM Needs Key: The selected AI provider needs an API key.
Translation.Accounts Media Needs Source: Add a media source or API key before generation.
Translation.Accounts Source Needs Configuration: These enabled sources still need configuration: {sources}.
Translation.Accounts Upload Needs Key: Upload-Post is enabled but missing an API key.
Translation.Accounts Ready: Core accounts and API settings look ready.
Translation.Video Source Configuration Help: Checks selected sources locally. It does not spend API quota or send a generation request.
Translation.Performance Snapshot Help: Summarizes publish metrics against viral score predictions for recent jobs.
Translation.Monthly Cost Estimate Help: Shows the known portion of this month's rough LLM and TTS estimates. Jobs with missing rates are excluded from the total.
Translation.Cost Estimate Needs Rates: {count} job(s) have missing cost rates. The total only includes known estimates.
Translation.Analytics Needs Publish Metrics: Add publish metrics to calibrate future decisions.
Translation.Analytics Needs Viral Scores: Some metric samples are missing viral scores.
Translation.Analytics Ready: Publish metrics and viral scores are ready for review.
Translation.Brand CTA Soft: Invite viewers to follow for the next insight.
Translation.Brand CTA Direct: Ask viewers to follow, comment, or save.
Translation.Brand CTA Informational: Point viewers to the next related explanation.
Translation.Video Quality Impact Help: Practical effect of the current CRF, FPS, encoder preset, and audio bitrate settings.
Translation.DVIDS API Key: DVIDS API Key ([Get a free key](https://api.dvidshub.net/docs))
Translation.DVIDS API Key Help: A free DVIDS API key is required only when this public-media source is selected.
